name: GitHub Topics Trending
headline: GitHub Topics Trending - Track Trending Projects
short_description: Track trending GitHub projects by topic, analyze trends with AI, and receive daily email reports. Visualize data on GitHub Pages. Ideal for developers and operations teams monitoring open-source activity.
author: geekjourneyx

sections.overview:
GitHub Topics Trending is an automation system that monitors GitHub repositories by topic, fetches trending projects daily via GitHub API, and leverages Claude AI to summarize and categorize each repository. The system calculates star growth trends, detects emerging projects, and delivers professional HTML email reports with clickable repository links. It also generates a static GitHub Pages website for trend visualization and stores historical data in SQLite for ongoing analysis. Built for developers and operations teams who need to stay informed about open-source activity in specific domains without manual effort.
Monitor trending Claude Code plugins and integrations daily
Track emerging development tools and frameworks in your domain
Receive automated summaries of hot open-source projects with AI insights
Analyze repository growth trends and identify high-velocity projects

```
I want to track trending GitHub projects under the topic [TOPIC]. Please analyze the top 10 projects by stars, forks, and recent activity. Provide a daily email report format and suggest a GitHub Pages visualization approach. Focus on [INDUSTRY] trends.
```
